name: @zvec/zvec-grep
description: Agent-friendly hybrid code search with indexed context and managed ripgrep.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:package
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --include=dist/**/*.js --check-coverage --lines=80 --statements=80 --functions=80 --branches=80 npm run test:all
scripts.test:all: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/unit/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/integration/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/e2e/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/integration/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:all
